description: Ample storage meets classic style in the West Lake 6 Drawer Dresser. Six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer generous space for onesies, sleepers, blankets, and more, all within a solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple. The roomy top is perfectly sized for a changing pad, turning diaper time into a comfortable experience. Built to last through every childhood stage. Coordinates with the complete West Lake collection.
